        public static void RunSelfTestHardLinkRejection(HeldDirectory parent)
        {
            if (parent == null) throw new ArgumentNullException("parent");
            const string fixtureLeaf = "native-hardlink-fixture";
            const string sourceLeaf = "native-hardlink-source.bin";
            const string aliasLeaf = "native-hardlink-alias.bin";
            HeldDirectory fixture = CreateDirectoryNewCore(parent, fixtureLeaf, NativeMethods.FILE_SHARE_ALL);
            HeldFile source = CreateFileNewCore(fixture, sourceLeaf, NativeMethods.FILE_SHARE_ALL);
            NativeIdentity sourceBefore = source.Identity;
            NativeMethods.CreateHardLink(source, fixture, aliasLeaf);
            NativeIdentity linked = NativeMethods.SnapshotCore(source, null);
            if (linked.VolumeSerialNumber != sourceBefore.VolumeSerialNumber || linked.FileId != sourceBefore.FileId ||
                linked.IsDirectory || linked.LinkCount != 2 || linked.ReparseTag != 0)
                throw new NativeFsException("RunSelfTestHardLinkRejection", "hard-link fixture identity mismatch");
            fixture.UpdateIdentity(NativeMethods.SnapshotCore(fixture, null));
            RequireInventoryPair(fixture, sourceLeaf, aliasLeaf, linked, "RunSelfTestHardLinkRejection");
            source.Dispose();
            RequireFileOpenRejected(fixture, sourceLeaf, "RunSelfTestHardLinkRejection(source)");
            RequireFileOpenRejected(fixture, aliasLeaf, "RunSelfTestHardLinkRejection(alias)");

            source = OpenHardLinkFileForSelfTest(fixture, sourceLeaf, linked);
            source.SetDispositionAndClose();
            NativeMethods.FlushExact(fixture, "RunSelfTestHardLinkRejection(parent flush after source unlink)");
            fixture.UpdateIdentity(NativeMethods.SnapshotCore(fixture, null));
            RequireAbsentFolded(fixture, sourceLeaf, 16, 4096, "RunSelfTestHardLinkRejection(source unlink)");
            HeldFile alias = OpenFile(fixture, aliasLeaf, true);
            try
            {
                NativeIdentity aliasIdentity = SnapshotFile(alias, 0);
                if (aliasIdentity.VolumeSerialNumber != linked.VolumeSerialNumber || aliasIdentity.FileId != linked.FileId ||
                    aliasIdentity.LinkCount != 1 || aliasIdentity.ReparseTag != 0)
                    throw new NativeFsException("RunSelfTestHardLinkRejection", "surviving hard-link identity mismatch");
                DeleteFileSameHandle(fixture, alias, aliasIdentity, 16, 4096);
            }
            finally { alias.Dispose(); }
            RequireAbsentFolded(fixture, aliasLeaf, 16, 4096, "RunSelfTestHardLinkRejection(alias unlink)");
            DeleteEmptyDirectorySameHandle(parent, fixture, fixture.Identity, 16, 4096);
            fixture.Dispose();
            RequireAbsentFolded(parent, fixtureLeaf, 16, 4096, "RunSelfTestHardLinkRejection(fixture cleanup)");
        }

        public static void RunSelfTestReparseNoFollowRejection(HeldDirectory parent)
        {
            if (parent == null) throw new ArgumentNullException("parent");
            const string targetLeaf = "native-reparse-target";
            const string aliasLeaf = "native-reparse-alias";
            HeldDirectory target = CreateDirectoryNew(parent, targetLeaf);
            HeldDirectory alias = CreateDirectoryNewCore(parent, aliasLeaf, NativeMethods.FILE_SHARE_ALL);
            NativeIdentity targetBefore = target.Identity;
            NativeIdentity aliasBefore = alias.Identity;
            if (targetBefore.VolumeSerialNumber != aliasBefore.VolumeSerialNumber || targetBefore.FileId == aliasBefore.FileId)
                throw new NativeFsException("RunSelfTestReparseNoFollowRejection", "fixture directory identities invalid");
            byte[] expectedReparse = NativeMethods.BuildMountPointReparseBuffer(targetBefore.CanonicalPath);
            NativeMethods.SetReparsePoint(alias, expectedReparse);
            byte[] observedReparse = NativeMethods.GetReparsePoint(alias);
            if (!CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals(expectedReparse, observedReparse))
                throw new NativeFsException("RunSelfTestReparseNoFollowRejection", "reparse bytes mismatch");
            NativeIdentity aliasReparse = NativeMethods.SnapshotCore(alias, null);
            if (aliasReparse.VolumeSerialNumber != aliasBefore.VolumeSerialNumber || aliasReparse.FileId != aliasBefore.FileId ||
                aliasReparse.ReparseTag != NativeMethods.IO_REPARSE_TAG_MOUNT_POINT ||
                (aliasReparse.Attributes & NativeMethods.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT) == 0)
                throw new NativeFsException("RunSelfTestReparseNoFollowRejection", "reparse fixture identity mismatch");
            alias.Dispose();
            parent.UpdateIdentity(NativeMethods.SnapshotCore(parent, null));
            RequireDirectoryOpenRejected(parent, aliasLeaf, "RunSelfTestReparseNoFollowRejection(open)");
            RequireEnumerationRejected(parent, "RunSelfTestReparseNoFollowRejection(enumerate)");
            NativeIdentity targetAfterReject = NativeMethods.SnapshotCore(target, null);
            if (!targetBefore.SameCore(targetAfterReject) || Enumerate(target, 1, 1024).Count != 0)
                throw new NativeFsException("RunSelfTestReparseNoFollowRejection", "target changed through rejected reparse");

            alias = OpenReparseDirectoryForSelfTest(parent, aliasLeaf, aliasReparse);
            byte[] finalReparse = NativeMethods.GetReparsePoint(alias);
            if (!CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals(expectedReparse, finalReparse))
                throw new NativeFsException("RunSelfTestReparseNoFollowRejection", "reparse changed before cleanup");
            NativeMethods.DeleteReparsePoint(alias, NativeMethods.IO_REPARSE_TAG_MOUNT_POINT);
            NativeIdentity aliasPlain = NativeMethods.SnapshotCore(alias, null);
            if (aliasPlain.VolumeSerialNumber != aliasBefore.VolumeSerialNumber || aliasPlain.FileId != aliasBefore.FileId ||
                aliasPlain.ReparseTag != 0 || (aliasPlain.Attributes & NativeMethods.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT) != 0)
                throw new NativeFsException("RunSelfTestReparseNoFollowRejection", "reparse removal identity mismatch");
            alias.Dispose();
            parent.UpdateIdentity(NativeMethods.SnapshotCore(parent, null));
            alias = OpenDirectory(parent, aliasLeaf, true);
            if (alias.Identity.VolumeSerialNumber != aliasBefore.VolumeSerialNumber || alias.Identity.FileId != aliasBefore.FileId ||
                alias.Identity.ReparseTag != 0)
                throw new NativeFsException("RunSelfTestReparseNoFollowRejection", "reopened alias identity mismatch");
            if (Enumerate(alias, 1, 1024).Count != 0)
                throw new NativeFsException("RunSelfTestReparseNoFollowRejection", "alias directory not empty after reparse removal");
            DeleteEmptyDirectorySameHandle(parent, alias, alias.Identity, 16, 4096);
            alias.Dispose();
            DeleteEmptyDirectorySameHandle(parent, target, target.Identity, 16, 4096);
            target.Dispose();
            RequireAbsentFolded(parent, aliasLeaf, 16, 4096, "RunSelfTestReparseNoFollowRejection(alias cleanup)");
            RequireAbsentFolded(parent, targetLeaf, 16, 4096, "RunSelfTestReparseNoFollowRejection(target cleanup)");
        }

        public static void DeleteFileSameHandle(HeldDirectory parent, HeldFile file, NativeIdentity expected, int maxEntries, int maxUtf8NameBytes)
        {
            if (parent == null) throw new ArgumentNullException("parent");
            if (file == null) throw new ArgumentNullException("file");
            if (expected == null) throw new ArgumentNullException("expected");
            NativeIdentity parentBefore = RequireCurrentDirectory(parent, true, "DeleteFileSameHandle");
            RequireParentBinding(parentBefore, parent, file, "DeleteFileSameHandle");
            NativeIdentity actual = SnapshotFile(file, checked((long)Math.Max(0L, expected.Size)));
            if (!expected.SnapshotEquals(actual)) throw new NativeFsException("DeleteFileSameHandle", "target snapshot mismatch");
            RequireNewObject(actual, "DeleteFileSameHandle");
            RequireInventoryBinding(parent, file.Leaf, actual, maxEntries, maxUtf8NameBytes, "DeleteFileSameHandle");
            actual = SnapshotFile(file, checked((long)Math.Max(0L, expected.Size)));
            if (!expected.SnapshotEquals(actual)) throw new NativeFsException("DeleteFileSameHandle", "target changed after inventory validation");
            RequireParentBinding(parent.Identity, parent, file, "DeleteFileSameHandle");
            file.SetDispositionAndClose();
            NativeMethods.FlushExact(parent, "DeleteFileSameHandle(parent flush)");
            NativeIdentity parentAfter = NativeMethods.SnapshotCore(parent, null);
            if (!parentBefore.SameDirectoryObject(parentAfter))
                throw new NativeFsException("DeleteFileSameHandle", "parent changed during deletion");
            parent.UpdateIdentity(parentAfter);
            RequireAbsentFolded(parent, file.Leaf, maxEntries, maxUtf8NameBytes, "DeleteFileSameHandle");
        }

        public static void DeleteEmptyDirectorySameHandle(HeldDirectory parent, HeldDirectory child, NativeIdentity expected, int maxEntries, int maxUtf8NameBytes)
        {
            if (parent == null) throw new ArgumentNullException("parent");
            if (child == null) throw new ArgumentNullException("child");
            if (expected == null) throw new ArgumentNullException("expected");
            NativeIdentity parentBefore = RequireCurrentDirectory(parent, true, "DeleteEmptyDirectorySameHandle");
            RequireParentBinding(parentBefore, parent, child, "DeleteEmptyDirectorySameHandle");
            NativeIdentity actual = NativeMethods.SnapshotCore(child, null);
            if (!expected.SameCore(actual)) throw new NativeFsException("DeleteEmptyDirectorySameHandle", "target snapshot mismatch");
            RequireNewObject(actual, "DeleteEmptyDirectorySameHandle");
            IList<NativeDirectoryEntry> contents = Enumerate(child, maxEntries, maxUtf8NameBytes);
            if (contents.Count != 0) throw new NativeFsException("DeleteEmptyDirectorySameHandle", "target directory is not empty");
            actual = child.Identity;
            RequireInventoryBinding(parent, child.Leaf, actual, maxEntries, maxUtfNameBytes: maxUtf8NameBytes, operation: "DeleteEmptyDirectorySameHandle");
            NativeIdentity finalTarget = NativeMethods.SnapshotCore(child, null);
            if (!expected.SameCore(finalTarget)) throw new NativeFsException("DeleteEmptyDirectorySameHandle", "target changed after inventory validation");
            if (Enumerate(child, maxEntries, maxUtf8NameBytes).Count != 0)
                throw new NativeFsException("DeleteEmptyDirectorySameHandle", "target directory changed after inventory validation");
            RequireParentBinding(parent.Identity, parent, child, "DeleteEmptyDirectorySameHandle");
            child.SetDispositionAndClose();
            NativeMethods.FlushExact(parent, "DeleteEmptyDirectorySameHandle(parent flush)");
            NativeIdentity parentAfter = NativeMethods.SnapshotCore(parent, null);
            if (!parentBefore.SameDirectoryObject(parentAfter))
                throw new NativeFsException("DeleteEmptyDirectorySameHandle", "parent changed during deletion");
            parent.UpdateIdentity(parentAfter);
            RequireAbsentFolded(parent, child.Leaf, maxEntries, maxUtf8NameBytes, "DeleteEmptyDirectorySameHandle");
        }

        private static NativeIdentity RequireCurrentDirectory(HeldDirectory directory, bool requireMutable, string operation)
        {
            if (requireMutable && !directory.CanCreateChildren) throw new NativeFsException(operation, "directory was not opened with mutation rights");
            NativeIdentity expected = directory.Identity;
            NativeIdentity actual = NativeMethods.SnapshotCore(directory, null);
            NativeMethods.RequireAcceptable(actual, true, operation);
            if (!expected.SameCore(actual)) throw new NativeFsException(operation, "held directory identity changed");
            directory.UpdateIdentity(actual);
            return actual;
        }

        private static void RequireNewObject(NativeIdentity identity, string operation)
        {
            if (identity.LinkCount != 1) throw new NativeFsException(operation, "link count is not one");
            if (identity.ReparseTag != 0 || (identity.Attributes & NativeMethods.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT) != 0)
                throw new NativeFsException(operation, "reparse object rejected");
        }

        private static void RequireChildPath(NativeIdentity parent, string leaf, NativeIdentity child, string operation)
        {
            string expected = parent.CanonicalPath.EndsWith("/", StringComparison.Ordinal) ? parent.CanonicalPath + leaf : parent.CanonicalPath + "/" + leaf;
            if (child.VolumeSerialNumber != parent.VolumeSerialNumber || !String.Equals(child.CanonicalPath, expected, StringComparison.Ordinal))
                throw new NativeFsException(operation, "parent/leaf/final-path binding mismatch");
        }

        private static void RequireParentBinding(NativeIdentity parentIdentity, HeldDirectory parent, HeldObject child, string operation)
        {
            if (child.ParentObjectKey == null || child.Leaf == null || !String.Equals(child.ParentObjectKey, parentIdentity.ObjectKey, StringComparison.Ordinal))
                throw new NativeFsException(operation, "held parent binding mismatch");
            RequireChildPath(parentIdentity, child.Leaf, child.Identity, operation);
        }

        private static void RequireInventoryBinding(HeldDirectory parent, string leaf, NativeIdentity target, int maxEntries, int maxUtfNameBytes, string operation)
        {
            IList<NativeDirectoryEntry> entries = Enumerate(parent, maxEntries, maxUtfNameBytes);
            NativeDirectoryEntry match = null;
            foreach (NativeDirectoryEntry entry in entries)
            {
                if (String.Equals(entry.Name, leaf, StringComparison.Ordinal)) match = entry;
                else if (String.Equals(entry.Name, leaf, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    throw new NativeFsException(operation, "case-fold crossing in parent inventory");
            }
            if (match == null || match.FileId != target.FileId || match.IsDirectory != target.IsDirectory)
                throw new NativeFsException(operation, "parent inventory does not bind the held target");
        }

        private static void RequireInventoryPair(HeldDirectory parent, string firstLeaf, string secondLeaf, NativeIdentity target, string operation)
        {
            IList<NativeDirectoryEntry> entries = NativeMethods.QueryDirectory(parent, 16, 4096);
            NativeDirectoryEntry first = null;
            NativeDirectoryEntry second = null;
            foreach (NativeDirectoryEntry entry in entries)
            {
                if (String.Equals(entry.Name, firstLeaf, StringComparison.Ordinal)) first = entry;
                if (String.Equals(entry.Name, secondLeaf, StringComparison.Ordinal)) second = entry;
            }
            if (first == null || second == null || first.IsDirectory || second.IsDirectory ||
                first.FileId != target.FileId || second.FileId != target.FileId)
                throw new NativeFsException(operation, "hard-link inventory mismatch");
        }

        private static void RequireFileOpenRejected(HeldDirectory parent, string leaf, string operation)
        {
            HeldFile opened = null;
            try
            {
                opened = OpenFile(parent, leaf, false);
                throw new NativeFsException(operation, "hard-link open unexpectedly succeeded");
            }
            catch (NativeFsException error)
            {
                if (error.Operation == operation) throw;
                if (error.Operation != "OpenFile" || !error.Message.EndsWith(": link count is not one", StringComparison.Ordinal))
                    throw new NativeFsException(operation, "unexpected rejection: " + error.Message);
            }
            finally { if (opened != null) opened.Dispose(); }
        }

        private static void RequireDirectoryOpenRejected(HeldDirectory parent, string leaf, string operation)
        {
            HeldDirectory opened = null;
            try
            {
                opened = OpenDirectory(parent, leaf, false);
                throw new NativeFsException(operation, "reparse open unexpectedly succeeded");
            }
            catch (NativeFsException error)
            {
                if (error.Operation == operation) throw;
                if (error.Operation != "OpenDirectory" || !error.Message.EndsWith(": reparse object rejected", StringComparison.Ordinal))
                    throw new NativeFsException(operation, "unexpected rejection: " + error.Message);
            }
            finally { if (opened != null) opened.Dispose(); }
        }

        private static void RequireEnumerationRejected(HeldDirectory parent, string operation)
        {
            try
            {
                Enumerate(parent, 16, 4096);
                throw new NativeFsException(operation, "reparse inventory unexpectedly succeeded");
            }
            catch (NativeFsException error)
            {
                if (error.Operation == operation) throw;
                bool rawRejected = error.Operation == "NtQueryDirectoryFile" &&
                    error.Message.EndsWith(": reparse child rejected", StringComparison.Ordinal);
                bool heldRejected = error.Operation == "Enumerate(child)" &&
                    error.Message.EndsWith(": reparse object rejected", StringComparison.Ordinal);
                if (!rawRejected && !heldRejected)
                    throw new NativeFsException(operation, "unexpected rejection: " + error.Message);
            }
        }

        private static HeldDirectory OpenReparseDirectoryForSelfTest(HeldDirectory parent, string leaf, NativeIdentity expected)
        {
            NativeIdentity parentBefore = RequireCurrentDirectory(parent, true, "OpenReparseDirectoryForSelfTest");
            SafeFileHandle raw = NativeMethods.NtOpenRelative(parent, leaf, true, false,
                NativeMethods.DIRECTORY_MUTABLE_ACCESS, NativeMethods.FILE_SHARE_ALL);
            try
            {
                NativeIdentity actual = NativeMethods.SnapshotCore(raw, null);
                RequireChildPath(parentBefore, leaf, actual, "OpenReparseDirectoryForSelfTest");
                if (actual.VolumeSerialNumber != expected.VolumeSerialNumber || actual.FileId != expected.FileId ||
                    actual.ReparseTag != NativeMethods.IO_REPARSE_TAG_MOUNT_POINT ||
                    (actual.Attributes & NativeMethods.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT) == 0)
                    throw new NativeFsException("OpenReparseDirectoryForSelfTest", "reparse identity mismatch");
                NativeIdentity parentAfter = NativeMethods.SnapshotCore(parent, null);
                if (!parentBefore.SameCore(parentAfter))
                    throw new NativeFsException("OpenReparseDirectoryForSelfTest", "parent changed during open");
                parent.UpdateIdentity(parentAfter);
                return new HeldDirectory(raw, actual, parentAfter.ObjectKey, leaf, true, parent);
            }
            catch { raw.Dispose(); throw; }
        }

        private static HeldFile OpenHardLinkFileForSelfTest(HeldDirectory parent, string leaf, NativeIdentity expected)
        {
            NativeIdentity parentBefore = RequireCurrentDirectory(parent, true, "OpenHardLinkFileForSelfTest");
            SafeFileHandle raw = NativeMethods.NtOpenRelative(parent, leaf, false, false,
                NativeMethods.FILE_MUTABLE_ACCESS, NativeMethods.FILE_SHARE_ALL);
            try
            {
                NativeIdentity actual = NativeMethods.SnapshotCore(raw, null);
                RequireChildPath(parentBefore, leaf, actual, "OpenHardLinkFileForSelfTest");
                if (actual.VolumeSerialNumber != expected.VolumeSerialNumber || actual.FileId != expected.FileId ||
                    actual.LinkCount != 2 || actual.ReparseTag != 0)
                    throw new NativeFsException("OpenHardLinkFileForSelfTest", "hard-link identity mismatch");
                NativeIdentity parentAfter = NativeMethods.SnapshotCore(parent, null);
                if (!parentBefore.SameCore(parentAfter))
                    throw new NativeFsException("OpenHardLinkFileForSelfTest", "parent changed during open");
                parent.UpdateIdentity(parentAfter);
                return new HeldFile(raw, actual, parentAfter.ObjectKey, leaf);
            }
            catch { raw.Dispose(); throw; }
        }

        private static void RequireAbsentFolded(HeldDirectory parent, string leaf, int maxEntries, int maxUtfNameBytes, string operation)
        {
            IList<NativeDirectoryEntry> entries = Enumerate(parent, maxEntries, maxUtfNameBytes);
            foreach (NativeDirectoryEntry entry in entries)
                if (String.Equals(entry.Name, leaf, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                    throw new NativeFsException(operation, "target leaf remains or was replaced");
        }

        private static bool IsAsciiLetter(char c) { return (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') || (c >= 'a' && c <= 'z'); }
    }

    internal static class NativeMethods
    {
        internal const uint FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY = 0x00000010;
        internal const uint FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL = 0x00000080;
        internal const uint FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT = 0x00000400;
        internal const uint IO_REPARSE_TAG_MOUNT_POINT = 0xA0000003;
        internal const uint FILE_SHARE_READ = 0x00000001;
        private const uint FILE_SHARE_WRITE = 0x00000002;
        private const uint FILE_SHARE_DELETE = 0x00000004;
        internal const uint FILE_SHARE_ALL = FILE_SHARE_READ | FILE_SHARE_WRITE | FILE_SHARE_DELETE;
        internal const uint OPEN_EXISTING = 3;
        internal const uint FILE_FLAG_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT = 0x00200000;
        internal const uint FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS = 0x02000000;
        internal const uint FILE_FLAG_OVERLAPPED = 0x40000000;
        private const uint FILE_READ_DATA = 0x00000001;
        private const uint FILE_LIST_DIRECTORY = 0x00000001;
        private const uint FILE_WRITE_DATA = 0x00000002;
        private const uint FILE_ADD_FILE = 0x00000002;
        private const uint FILE_ADD_SUBDIRECTORY = 0x00000004;
        private const uint FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES = 0x00000080;
        private const uint FILE_WRITE_ATTRIBUTES = 0x00000100;
        private const uint DELETE = 0x00010000;
        private const uint SYNCHRONIZE = 0x00100000;
        internal const uint DIRECTORY_READ_ACCESS = FILE_LIST_DIRECTORY | FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES | SYNCHRONIZE;
        internal const uint DIRECTORY_MUTABLE_ACCESS = FILE_LIST_DIRECTORY | FILE_ADD_FILE | FILE_ADD_SUBDIRECTORY | FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES | FILE_WRITE_ATTRIBUTES | DELETE | SYNCHRONIZE;
        internal const uint DIRECTORY_CREATED_ACCESS = DIRECTORY_MUTABLE_ACCESS;
        internal const uint FILE_READ_ACCESS = FILE_READ_DATA | FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES | SYNCHRONIZE;
        internal const uint FILE_MUTABLE_ACCESS = FILE_READ_DATA | FILE_WRITE_DATA | FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES | FILE_WRITE_ATTRIBUTES | DELETE | SYNCHRONIZE;
        internal const uint FILE_CREATED_ACCESS = FILE_MUTABLE_ACCESS;
        private const uint OBJ_CASE_INSENSITIVE = 0x00000040;
        private const uint OBJ_DONT_REPARSE = 0x00001000;
        private const uint FILE_DIRECTORY_FILE = 0x00000001;
        private const uint FILE_SYNCHRONOUS_IO_NONALERT = 0x00000020;
        private const uint FILE_NON_DIRECTORY_FILE = 0x00000040;
        private const uint FILE_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT = 0x00200000;
        private const uint FILE_OPEN = 1;
        private const uint FILE_CREATE = 2;
        private const ulong FILE_OPENED = 1;
        private const ulong FILE_CREATED = 2;
        private const int FILE_ID_BOTH_DIR_INFORMATION_CLASS = 37;
        private const int FILE_DISPOSITION_INFORMATION_EX_CLASS = 64;
        private const uint FILE_DISPOSITION_DELETE = 0x00000001;
        private const uint FILE_DISPOSITION_POSIX_SEMANTICS = 0x00000002;
        private const int STATUS_SUCCESS = 0;
        private const int STATUS_PENDING = 0x00000103;
        private const int STATUS_NO_MORE_FILES = unchecked((int)0x80000006);
        private const uint DUPLICATE_SAME_ACCESS = 0x00000002;
        private const uint FILE_TYPE_DISK = 0x00000001;
        private const int FILE_BASIC_INFO_CLASS = 0;
        private const int FILE_STANDARD_INFO_CLASS = 1;
        private const int FILE_ATTRIBUTE_TAG_INFO_CLASS = 9;
        private const int FILE_CASE_SENSITIVE_INFO_CLASS = 23;
        private const int FILE_LINK_INFO_CLASS = 11;
        private const uint FSCTL_SET_REPARSE_POINT = 0x000900A4;
        private const uint FSCTL_GET_REPARSE_POINT = 0x000900A8;
        private const uint FSCTL_DELETE_REPARSE_POINT = 0x000900AC;
        private const int MAXIMUM_REPARSE_DATA_BUFFER_SIZE = 16 * 1024;
        private const uint FILE_CS_FLAG_CASE_SENSITIVE_DIR = 0x00000001;
        private const int ERROR_INVALID_FUNCTION = 1;
        private const int ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER = 87;
        internal const int ERROR_OPERATION_ABORTED = 995;
        internal const int ERROR_IO_PENDING = 997;
        internal const int ERROR_NOT_FOUND = 1168;
        internal const uint WAIT_OBJECT_0 = 0x00000000;
        internal const uint WAIT_TIMEOUT = 0x00000102;
        internal const uint DIRECTORY_NOTIFY_FILTER = 0x00000001 | 0x00000002 | 0x00000004 | 0x00000008 |
            0x00000010 | 0x00000040 | 0x00000100;
        private const long WINDOWS_TO_UNIX_EPOCH_100NS = 116444736000000000L;
        private const int QUERY_BUFFER_SIZE = 65536;
        private static readonly UnicodeEncoding StrictUnicode = new UnicodeEncoding(false, false, true);
        private static readonly UTF8Encoding StrictUtf8 = new UTF8Encoding(false, true);

        internal static SafeFileHandle OpenDirectoryWatch(HeldDirectory directory)
        {
            if (directory == null) throw new ArgumentNullException("directory");
            NativeIdentity before = SnapshotCore(directory, null);
            SafeFileHandle result;
            HeldDirectory parent = directory.ParentDirectory;
            if (parent == null)
            {
                if (before.CanonicalPath.Length != 3 || before.CanonicalPath[1] != ':' || before.CanonicalPath[2] != '/')
                    throw new NativeFsException("OpenDirectoryWatch", "parentless directory is not a drive anchor");
                string path = @"\\?\" + before.CanonicalPath.Replace('/', '\\');
                result = CreateFileW(path, DIRECTORY_READ_ACCESS, FILE_SHARE_ALL, IntPtr.Zero, OPEN_EXISTING,
                    FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS | FILE_FLAG_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT | FILE_FLAG_OVERLAPPED, IntPtr.Zero);
                if (result.IsInvalid)
                {
                    int error = Marshal.GetLastWin32Error();
                    result.Dispose();
                    throw Win32Failure("CreateFileW(directory watch anchor)", error);
                }
            }
            else
            {
                result = NtOpenRelativeAsynchronousDirectory(parent, directory.Leaf);
            }
            try
            {
                NativeIdentity watched = SnapshotCore(result, null);
                RequireAcceptable(watched, true, "OpenDirectoryWatch");
                RequireCaseInsensitiveDirectory(result, "OpenDirectoryWatch");
                NativeIdentity after = SnapshotCore(directory, null);
                if (!before.SameCore(watched) || !before.SameCore(after))
                    throw new NativeFsException("OpenDirectoryWatch", "directory identity changed during asynchronous relative reopen");
                return result;
            }
            catch { result.Dispose(); throw; }
        }

        internal static SafeFileHandle NtOpenRelative(HeldDirectory parent, string leaf, bool directory, bool createNew,
            uint desiredAccess, uint shareAccess)
        {
            ValidateLeaf(leaf);
            return parent.WithHandle(delegate(IntPtr parentHandle)
            {
                IntPtr nameBuffer = IntPtr.Zero;
                IntPtr unicodeBuffer = IntPtr.Zero;
                try
                {
                    nameBuffer = Marshal.StringToHGlobalUni(leaf);
                    UNICODE_STRING name = new UNICODE_STRING();
                    name.Length = checked((ushort)(leaf.Length * 2));
                    name.MaximumLength = name.Length;
                    name.Buffer = nameBuffer;
                    unicodeBuffer = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(UNICODE_STRING)));
                    Marshal.StructureToPtr(name, unicodeBuffer, false);
                    OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES attributes = new OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES();
                    attributes.Length = checked((uint)Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES)));
                    attributes.RootDirectory = parentHandle;
                    attributes.ObjectName = unicodeBuffer;
                    attributes.Attributes = OBJ_CASE_INSENSITIVE | OBJ_DONT_REPARSE;
                    IO_STATUS_BLOCK io;
                    IntPtr result;
                    uint options = FILE_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT | FILE_SYNCHRONOUS_IO_NONALERT |
                        (directory ? FILE_DIRECTORY_FILE : FILE_NON_DIRECTORY_FILE);
                    int status = NtCreateFile(out result, desiredAccess, ref attributes, out io, IntPtr.Zero,
                        createNew ? (directory ? FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY : FILE_ATTRIBUTE_NORMAL) : 0,
                        shareAccess, createNew ? FILE_CREATE : FILE_OPEN, options, IntPtr.Zero, 0);
                    if (status != STATUS_SUCCESS)
                    {
                        if (result != IntPtr.Zero && result != new IntPtr(-1)) CloseHandle(result);
                        throw new NativeFsException("NtCreateFile(" + (createNew ? "create" : "open") + ")", status);
                    }
                    ulong information = io.Information.ToUInt64();
                    ulong expectedInformation = createNew ? FILE_CREATED : FILE_OPENED;
                    if (result == IntPtr.Zero || result == new IntPtr(-1) || information != expectedInformation)
                    {
                        if (result != IntPtr.Zero && result != new IntPtr(-1)) CloseHandle(result);
                        throw new NativeFsException("NtCreateFile", "unexpected result handle or create information");
                    }
                    return new SafeFileHandle(result, true);
                }
                finally
                {
                    if (unicodeBuffer != IntPtr.Zero) Marshal.FreeHGlobal(unicodeBuffer);
                    if (nameBuffer != IntPtr.Zero) Marshal.FreeHGlobal(nameBuffer);
                }
            });
        }

        private static SafeFileHandle NtOpenRelativeAsynchronousDirectory(HeldDirectory parent, string leaf)
        {
            ValidateLeaf(leaf);
            return parent.WithHandle(delegate(IntPtr parentHandle)
            {
                IntPtr nameBuffer = IntPtr.Zero;
                IntPtr unicodeBuffer = IntPtr.Zero;
                IntPtr ioBuffer = IntPtr.Zero;
                IntPtr result = IntPtr.Zero;
                bool abandon = false;
                try
                {
                    nameBuffer = Marshal.StringToHGlobalUni(leaf);
                    UNICODE_STRING name = new UNICODE_STRING();
                    name.Length = checked((ushort)(leaf.Length * 2));
                    name.MaximumLength = name.Length;
                    name.Buffer = nameBuffer;
                    unicodeBuffer = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(UNICODE_STRING)));
                    Marshal.StructureToPtr(name, unicodeBuffer, false);
                    OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES attributes = new OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES();
                    attributes.Length = checked((uint)Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(OBJECT_ATTRIBUTES)));
                    attributes.RootDirectory = parentHandle;
                    attributes.ObjectName = unicodeBuffer;
                    attributes.Attributes = OBJ_CASE_INSENSITIVE | OBJ_DONT_REPARSE;
                    ioBuffer = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(IO_STATUS_BLOCK)));
                    for (int index = 0; index < Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(IO_STATUS_BLOCK)); ++index)
                        Marshal.WriteByte(ioBuffer, index, 0);
                    int status = NtCreateFilePointer(out result, DIRECTORY_READ_ACCESS, ref attributes, ioBuffer,
                        IntPtr.Zero, 0, FILE_SHARE_ALL, FILE_OPEN,
                        FILE_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT | FILE_DIRECTORY_FILE, IntPtr.Zero, 0);
                    if (status == STATUS_PENDING)
                    {
                        uint wait = WaitForSingleObject(result, 5000);
                        if (wait != WAIT_OBJECT_0)
                        {
                            abandon = true;
                            throw new NativeFsException("NtCreateFile(asynchronous directory watch)",
                                wait == WAIT_TIMEOUT ? "asynchronous relative open timed out" : "asynchronous relative open wait failed");
                        }
                        IO_STATUS_BLOCK completed = (IO_STATUS_BLOCK)Marshal.PtrToStructure(ioBuffer, typeof(IO_STATUS_BLOCK));
                        status = unchecked((int)completed.Status.ToInt64());
                    }
                    if (status != STATUS_SUCCESS)
                    {
                        if (result != IntPtr.Zero && result != new IntPtr(-1)) CloseHandle(result);
                        result = IntPtr.Zero;
                        throw new NativeFsException("NtCreateFile(asynchronous directory watch)", status);
                    }
                    IO_STATUS_BLOCK io = (IO_STATUS_BLOCK)Marshal.PtrToStructure(ioBuffer, typeof(IO_STATUS_BLOCK));
                    if (result == IntPtr.Zero || result == new IntPtr(-1) || io.Information.ToUInt64() != FILE_OPENED)
                    {
                        if (result != IntPtr.Zero && result != new IntPtr(-1)) CloseHandle(result);
                        result = IntPtr.Zero;
                        throw new NativeFsException("NtCreateFile(asynchronous directory watch)", "unexpected result handle or open information");
                    }
                    SafeFileHandle safe = new SafeFileHandle(result, true);
                    result = IntPtr.Zero;
                    return safe;
                }
                finally
                {
                    if (!abandon)
                    {
                        if (result != IntPtr.Zero && result != new IntPtr(-1)) CloseHandle(result);
                        if (ioBuffer != IntPtr.Zero) Marshal.FreeHGlobal(ioBuffer);
                        if (unicodeBuffer != IntPtr.Zero) Marshal.FreeHGlobal(unicodeBuffer);
                        if (nameBuffer != IntPtr.Zero) Marshal.FreeHGlobal(nameBuffer);
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        internal static NativeIdentity SnapshotCore(HeldObject target, string sha256)
        {
            return target.WithHandle(delegate(IntPtr raw) { return SnapshotCore(raw, sha256); });
        }

        internal static NativeIdentity SnapshotCore(SafeFileHandle target, string sha256)
        {
            bool added = false;
            try
            {
                target.DangerousAddRef(ref added);
                return SnapshotCore(target.DangerousGetHandle(), sha256);
            }
            finally { if (added) target.DangerousRelease(); }
        }

        private static NativeIdentity SnapshotCore(IntPtr raw, string sha256)
        {
            if (GetFileType(raw) != FILE_TYPE_DISK) throw new NativeFsException("SnapshotCore", "handle is not a disk file");
            BY_HANDLE_FILE_INFORMATION legacy;
            if (!GetFileInformationByHandle(raw, out legacy)) throw LastWin32("GetFileInformationByHandle");
            FILE_BASIC_INFO basic;
            if (!GetFileInformationByHandleExBasic(raw, FILE_BASIC_INFO_CLASS, out basic, checked((uint)Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(FILE_BASIC_INFO)))))
                throw LastWin32("GetFileInformationByHandleEx(FileBasicInfo)");
            FILE_STANDARD_INFO standard;
            if (!GetFileInformationByHandleExStandard(raw, FILE_STANDARD_INFO_CLASS, out standard, checked((uint)Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(FILE_STANDARD_INFO)))))
                throw LastWin32("GetFileInformationByHandleEx(FileStandardInfo)");
            FILE_ATTRIBUTE_TAG_INFO tag;
            if (!GetFileInformationByHandleExTag(raw, FILE_ATTRIBUTE_TAG_INFO_CLASS, out tag, checked((uint)Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(FILE_ATTRIBUTE_TAG_INFO)))))
                throw LastWin32("GetFileInformationByHandleEx(FileAttributeTagInfo)");
            if (standard.EndOfFile < 0 || standard.DeletePending) throw new NativeFsException("SnapshotCore", "negative size or delete-pending handle");
            bool directory = standard.Directory;
            bool attributeDirectory = (tag.FileAttributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY) != 0;
            if (directory != attributeDirectory) throw new NativeFsException("SnapshotCore", "directory type fields disagree");
            ulong fileId = ((ulong)legacy.FileIndexHigh << 32) | legacy.FileIndexLow;
            ulong volume = legacy.VolumeSerialNumber;
            uint reparseTag = (tag.FileAttributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT) == 0 ? 0U : tag.ReparseTag;
            return new NativeIdentity(GetFinalPath(raw), volume, fileId, standard.EndOfFile,
                ToUnixNs(basic.LastWriteTime), ToUnixNs(basic.ChangeTime), standard.NumberOfLinks,
                tag.FileAttributes, reparseTag, directory, sha256);
        }

        internal static void RequireAcceptable(NativeIdentity identity, bool expectedDirectory, string operation)
        {
            if (identity.IsDirectory != expectedDirectory) throw new NativeFsException(operation, "unexpected object type");
            if (identity.ReparseTag != 0 || (identity.Attributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT) != 0)
                throw new NativeFsException(operation, "reparse object rejected");
            if (identity.LinkCount != 1) throw new NativeFsException(operation, "link count is not one");
        }

        internal static void CreateHardLink(HeldFile source, HeldDirectory parent, string aliasLeaf)
        {
            if (source == null) throw new ArgumentNullException("source");
            if (parent == null) throw new ArgumentNullException("parent");
            ValidateLeaf(aliasLeaf);
            byte[] nameBytes = StrictUnicode.GetBytes(aliasLeaf);
            int rootOffset = IntPtr.Size;
            int lengthOffset = checked(rootOffset + IntPtr.Size);
            int nameOffset = checked(lengthOffset + sizeof(uint));
            int totalLength = checked(nameOffset + nameBytes.Length);
            IntPtr buffer = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(totalLength);
            try
            {
                for (int i = 0; i < totalLength; ++i) Marshal.WriteByte(buffer, i, 0);
                parent.WithHandle(delegate(IntPtr parentRaw)
                {
                    Marshal.WriteIntPtr(buffer, rootOffset, parentRaw);
                    Marshal.WriteInt32(buffer, lengthOffset, nameBytes.Length);
                    Marshal.Copy(nameBytes, 0, IntPtr.Add(buffer, nameOffset), nameBytes.Length);
                    source.WithHandle(delegate(IntPtr sourceRaw)
                    {
                        IO_STATUS_BLOCK io;
                        int status = NtSetInformationFileBuffer(sourceRaw, out io, buffer, checked((uint)totalLength), FILE_LINK_INFO_CLASS);
                        if (status != STATUS_SUCCESS || unchecked((int)io.Status.ToInt64()) != STATUS_SUCCESS)
                            throw new NativeFsException("NtSetInformationFile(FileLinkInformation)",
                                status != STATUS_SUCCESS ? status : unchecked((int)io.Status.ToInt64()));
                        return 0;
                    });
                    return 0;
                });
            }
            finally { Marshal.FreeHGlobal(buffer); }
            FlushExact(source, "CreateHardLink(source flush)");
            FlushExact(parent, "CreateHardLink(parent flush)");
        }

        internal static byte[] BuildMountPointReparseBuffer(string targetCanonicalPath)
        {
            if (String.IsNullOrEmpty(targetCanonicalPath) || targetCanonicalPath.Length < 3 || targetCanonicalPath[1] != ':' ||
                targetCanonicalPath[2] != '/')
                throw new NativeFsException("BuildMountPointReparseBuffer", "target path is not canonical DOS form");
            string printName = targetCanonicalPath.Replace('/', '\\');
            string substituteName = @"\??\" + printName;
            byte[] substitute = StrictUnicode.GetBytes(substituteName);
            byte[] print = StrictUnicode.GetBytes(printName);
            int pathBytes = checked(substitute.Length + 2 + print.Length + 2);
            int dataLength = checked(8 + pathBytes);
            int totalLength = checked(8 + dataLength);
            if (totalLength > MAXIMUM_REPARSE_DATA_BUFFER_SIZE || dataLength > UInt16.MaxValue ||
                substitute.Length > UInt16.MaxValue || print.Length > UInt16.MaxValue)
                throw new NativeFsException("BuildMountPointReparseBuffer", "reparse buffer exceeds bound");
            byte[] buffer = new byte[totalLength];
            WriteUInt32(buffer, 0, IO_REPARSE_TAG_MOUNT_POINT);
            WriteUInt16(buffer, 4, checked((ushort)dataLength));
            WriteUInt16(buffer, 6, 0);
            WriteUInt16(buffer, 8, 0);
            WriteUInt16(buffer, 10, checked((ushort)substitute.Length));
            WriteUInt16(buffer, 12, checked((ushort)(substitute.Length + 2)));
            WriteUInt16(buffer, 14, checked((ushort)print.Length));
            Buffer.BlockCopy(substitute, 0, buffer, 16, substitute.Length);
            Buffer.BlockCopy(print, 0, buffer, checked(16 + substitute.Length + 2), print.Length);
            return buffer;
        }

        internal static void SetReparsePoint(HeldDirectory directory, byte[] buffer)
        {
            if (directory == null) throw new ArgumentNullException("directory");
            ValidateReparseBuffer(buffer, "SetReparsePoint");
            directory.WithHandle(delegate(IntPtr raw)
            {
                uint returned;
                if (!DeviceIoControl(raw, FSCTL_SET_REPARSE_POINT, buffer, checked((uint)buffer.Length), null, 0, out returned, IntPtr.Zero))
                    throw LastWin32("DeviceIoControl(FSCTL_SET_REPARSE_POINT)");
                if (returned != 0) throw new NativeFsException("SetReparsePoint", "unexpected returned byte count");
                return 0;
            });
            FlushExact(directory, "SetReparsePoint(directory flush)");
        }

        internal static byte[] GetReparsePoint(HeldDirectory directory)
        {
            if (directory == null) throw new ArgumentNullException("directory");
            return directory.WithHandle(delegate(IntPtr raw)
            {
                byte[] output = new byte[MAXIMUM_REPARSE_DATA_BUFFER_SIZE];
                uint returned;
                if (!DeviceIoControl(raw, FSCTL_GET_REPARSE_POINT, null, 0, output, checked((uint)output.Length), out returned, IntPtr.Zero))
                    throw LastWin32("DeviceIoControl(FSCTL_GET_REPARSE_POINT)");
                if (returned < 8 || returned > output.Length) throw new NativeFsException("GetReparsePoint", "invalid returned byte count");
                byte[] result = new byte[checked((int)returned)];
                Buffer.BlockCopy(output, 0, result, 0, result.Length);
                ValidateReparseBuffer(result, "GetReparsePoint");
                return result;
            });
        }

        internal static void DeleteReparsePoint(HeldDirectory directory, uint expectedTag)
        {
            if (directory == null) throw new ArgumentNullException("directory");
            byte[] buffer = new byte[8];
            WriteUInt32(buffer, 0, expectedTag);
            directory.WithHandle(delegate(IntPtr raw)
            {
                uint returned;
                if (!DeviceIoControl(raw, FSCTL_DELETE_REPARSE_POINT, buffer, checked((uint)buffer.Length), null, 0, out returned, IntPtr.Zero))
                    throw LastWin32("DeviceIoControl(FSCTL_DELETE_REPARSE_POINT)");
                if (returned != 0) throw new NativeFsException("DeleteReparsePoint", "unexpected returned byte count");
                return 0;
            });
            FlushExact(directory, "DeleteReparsePoint(directory flush)");
        }

        private static void ValidateReparseBuffer(byte[] buffer, string operation)
        {
            if (buffer == null || buffer.Length < 16 || buffer.Length > MAXIMUM_REPARSE_DATA_BUFFER_SIZE)
                throw new NativeFsException(operation, "reparse buffer length rejected");
            if (ReadUInt32(buffer, 0) != IO_REPARSE_TAG_MOUNT_POINT || ReadUInt16(buffer, 6) != 0 ||
                checked(8 + ReadUInt16(buffer, 4)) != buffer.Length)
                throw new NativeFsException(operation, "reparse buffer header rejected");
            int substituteOffset = ReadUInt16(buffer, 8);
            int substituteLength = ReadUInt16(buffer, 10);
            int printOffset = ReadUInt16(buffer, 12);
            int printLength = ReadUInt16(buffer, 14);
            int pathBytes = buffer.Length - 16;
            if (substituteOffset != 0 || (substituteLength & 1) != 0 || (printOffset & 1) != 0 || (printLength & 1) != 0 ||
                substituteLength < 8 || printOffset != checked(substituteLength + 2) ||
                checked(printOffset + printLength + 2) != pathBytes)
                throw new NativeFsException(operation, "reparse name offsets rejected");
            if (buffer[checked(16 + substituteLength)] != 0 || buffer[checked(16 + substituteLength + 1)] != 0 ||
                buffer[checked(16 + printOffset + printLength)] != 0 || buffer[checked(16 + printOffset + printLength + 1)] != 0)
                throw new NativeFsException(operation, "reparse terminators rejected");
        }

        private static ushort ReadUInt16(byte[] buffer, int offset)
        {
            return checked((ushort)(buffer[offset] | (buffer[offset + 1] << 8)));
        }

        private static uint ReadUInt32(byte[] buffer, int offset)
        {
            return unchecked((uint)(buffer[offset] | (buffer[offset + 1] << 8) | (buffer[offset + 2] << 16) | (buffer[offset + 3] << 24)));
        }

        private static void WriteUInt16(byte[] buffer, int offset, ushort value)
        {
            buffer[offset] = checked((byte)(value & 0xff));
            buffer[offset + 1] = checked((byte)(value >> 8));
        }

        private static void WriteUInt32(byte[] buffer, int offset, uint value)
        {
            buffer[offset] = checked((byte)(value & 0xff));
            buffer[offset + 1] = checked((byte)((value >> 8) & 0xff));
            buffer[offset + 2] = checked((byte)((value >> 16) & 0xff));
            buffer[offset + 3] = checked((byte)((value >> 24) & 0xff));
        }

        internal static void RequireCaseInsensitiveDirectory(SafeFileHandle handle, string operation)
        {
            bool added = false;
            try
            {
                handle.DangerousAddRef(ref added);
                FILE_CASE_SENSITIVE_INFO info;
                if (!GetFileInformationByHandleExCase(handle.DangerousGetHandle(), FILE_CASE_SENSITIVE_INFO_CLASS, out info,
                    checked((uint)Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(FILE_CASE_SENSITIVE_INFO)))))
                {
                    throw LastWin32(operation + "(FileCaseSensitiveInfo)");
                }
                if ((info.Flags & FILE_CS_FLAG_CASE_SENSITIVE_DIR) != 0)
                    throw new NativeFsException(operation, "case-sensitive directory rejected");
                if ((info.Flags & ~FILE_CS_FLAG_CASE_SENSITIVE_DIR) != 0)
                    throw new NativeFsException(operation, "unknown case-sensitivity flags rejected");
            }
            finally { if (added) handle.DangerousRelease(); }
        }

        internal static void FlushExact(HeldObject target, string operation)
        {
            target.WithHandle(delegate(IntPtr raw)
            {
                IO_STATUS_BLOCK io;
                int status = NtFlushBuffersFile(raw, out io);
                if (status != STATUS_SUCCESS || unchecked((int)io.Status.ToInt64()) != STATUS_SUCCESS)
                    throw new NativeFsException(operation, status != STATUS_SUCCESS ? status : unchecked((int)io.Status.ToInt64()));
                return 0;
            });
        }

        internal static IList<NativeDirectoryEntry> QueryDirectory(HeldDirectory directory, int maxEntries, int maxUtf8NameBytes)
        {
            return directory.WithHandle(delegate(IntPtr raw)
            {
                List<NativeDirectoryEntry> entries = new List<NativeDirectoryEntry>();
                HashSet<string> exact = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.Ordinal);
                HashSet<string> folded = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
                int utf8Bytes = 0;
                int calls = 0;
                bool restart = true;
                IntPtr buffer = Marshal.AllocHGlobal(QUERY_BUFFER_SIZE);
                try
                {
                    while (true)
                    {
                        calls = checked(calls + 1);
                        if (calls > checked(maxEntries + 2)) throw new NativeFsException("NtQueryDirectoryFile", "query-call bound exceeded");
                        IO_STATUS_BLOCK io;
                        int status = NtQueryDirectoryFile(raw, IntPtr.Zero, IntPtr.Zero, IntPtr.Zero, out io,
                            buffer, QUERY_BUFFER_SIZE, FILE_ID_BOTH_DIR_INFORMATION_CLASS, false, IntPtr.Zero, restart);
                        restart = false;
                        if (status == STATUS_NO_MORE_FILES) break;
                        if (status != STATUS_SUCCESS) throw new NativeFsException("NtQueryDirectoryFile", status);
                        ulong used64 = io.Information.ToUInt64();
                        if (used64 == 0 || used64 > QUERY_BUFFER_SIZE) throw new NativeFsException("NtQueryDirectoryFile", "invalid returned byte count");
                        int used = checked((int)used64);
                        int offset = 0;
                        while (true)
                        {
                            const int fixedBytes = 104;
                            if (offset < 0 || offset > used - fixedBytes) throw new NativeFsException("NtQueryDirectoryFile", "truncated directory record");
                            uint next = unchecked((uint)Marshal.ReadInt32(buffer, offset));
                            long size = Marshal.ReadInt64(buffer, offset + 40);
                            uint attributes = unchecked((uint)Marshal.ReadInt32(buffer, offset + 56));
                            uint nameByteCountRaw = unchecked((uint)Marshal.ReadInt32(buffer, offset + 60));
                            long fileIdSigned = Marshal.ReadInt64(buffer, offset + 96);
                            if (size < 0 || (nameByteCountRaw & 1U) != 0) throw new NativeFsException("NtQueryDirectoryFile", "invalid size or UTF-16 byte count");
                            int nameByteCount = checked((int)nameByteCountRaw);
                            int recordMinimum = checked(fixedBytes + nameByteCount);
                            if (recordMinimum > used - offset) throw new NativeFsException("NtQueryDirectoryFile", "name exceeds returned record");
                            byte[] nameBytes = new byte[nameByteCount];
                            if (nameByteCount != 0) Marshal.Copy(IntPtr.Add(buffer, offset + fixedBytes), nameBytes, 0, nameByteCount);
                            string name;
                            try { name = StrictUnicode.GetString(nameBytes); }
                            catch (DecoderFallbackException ex) { throw new NativeFsException("NtQueryDirectoryFile", "invalid UTF-16 name: " + ex.GetType().Name); }
                            if (name != "." && name != "..")
                            {
                                ValidateLeaf(name);
                                if ((attributes & FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT) != 0) throw new NativeFsException("NtQueryDirectoryFile", "reparse child rejected");
                                if (!exact.Add(name) || !folded.Add(name)) throw new NativeFsException("NtQueryDirectoryFile", "duplicate or case-fold-colliding name");
                                utf8Bytes = checked(utf8Bytes + StrictUtf8.GetByteCount(name));
                                if (utf8Bytes > maxUtf8NameBytes) throw new NativeFsException("NtQueryDirectoryFile", "UTF-8 name-byte bound exceeded");
                                entries.Add(new NativeDirectoryEntry(name, unchecked((ulong)fileIdSigned), size, attributes));
                                if (entries.Count > maxEntries) throw new NativeFsException("NtQueryDirectoryFile", "entry-count bound exceeded");
                            }
                            if (next == 0) break;
                            if ((next & 7U) != 0 || next < recordMinimum || next > checked((uint)(used - offset)))
                                throw new NativeFsException("NtQueryDirectoryFile", "invalid next-entry offset");
                            offset = checked(offset + (int)next);
                        }
                    }
                }
                finally { Marshal.FreeHGlobal(buffer); }
                entries.Sort(delegate(NativeDirectoryEntry a, NativeDirectoryEntry b) { return StringComparer.Ordinal.Compare(a.Name, b.Name); });
                return (IList<NativeDirectoryEntry>)entries.AsReadOnly();
            });
        }

        internal static void ValidateLeaf(string leaf)
        {
            if (leaf == null) throw new ArgumentNullException("leaf");
            if (leaf.Length == 0 || leaf.Length > 255) throw new NativeFsException("ValidateLeaf", "leaf length rejected");
            if (!leaf.IsNormalized(NormalizationForm.FormC)) throw new NativeFsException("ValidateLeaf", "leaf is not NFC");
            if (leaf == "." || leaf == ".." || leaf[leaf.Length - 1] == ' ' || leaf[leaf.Length - 1] == '.')
                throw new NativeFsException("ValidateLeaf", "dot/trailing-space shape rejected");
            for (int i = 0; i < leaf.Length; ++i)
            {
                char c = leaf[i];
                if (Char.IsControl(c) || Char.IsSurrogate(c) || c == '/' || c == '\\' || c == ':' || c == '*' ||
                    c == '?' || c == '<' || c == '>' || c == '|' || c == '"')
                    throw new NativeFsException("ValidateLeaf", "invalid leaf character");
            }
            string stem = leaf;
            int dot = leaf.IndexOf('.');
            if (dot >= 0) stem = leaf.Substring(0, dot);
            string upper = stem.ToUpperInvariant();
            if (upper == "CON" || upper == "PRN" || upper == "AUX" || upper == "NUL" || IsDosPortName(upper))
                throw new NativeFsException("ValidateLeaf", "DOS device name rejected");
            try { StrictUtf8.GetBytes(leaf); }
            catch (EncoderFallbackException ex) { throw new NativeFsException("ValidateLeaf", "invalid Unicode: " + ex.GetType().Name); }
        }

        private static bool IsDosPortName(string upper)
        {
            if (upper.Length != 4) return false;
            if (!(upper.StartsWith("COM", StringComparison.Ordinal) || upper.StartsWith("LPT", StringComparison.Ordinal))) return false;
            char n = upper[3];
            return (n >= '1' && n <= '9') || n == '\u00b9' || n == '\u00b2' || n == '\u00b3';
        }

        internal static SafeFileHandle Duplicate(IntPtr source)
        {
            IntPtr duplicate;
            IntPtr process = GetCurrentProcess();
            if (!DuplicateHandle(process, source, process, out duplicate, 0, false, DUPLICATE_SAME_ACCESS)) throw LastWin32("DuplicateHandle");
            if (duplicate == IntPtr.Zero || duplicate == new IntPtr(-1)) throw new NativeFsException("DuplicateHandle", "invalid duplicate");
            return new SafeFileHandle(duplicate, true);
        }

        internal static void SetDeleteDisposition(IntPtr raw)
        {
            FILE_DISPOSITION_INFORMATION_EX disposition = new FILE_DISPOSITION_INFORMATION_EX();
            disposition.Flags = FILE_DISPOSITION_DELETE | FILE_DISPOSITION_POSIX_SEMANTICS;
            IO_STATUS_BLOCK io;
            int status = NtSetInformationFile(raw, out io, ref disposition,
                checked((uint)Marshal.SizeOf(typeof(FILE_DISPOSITION_INFORMATION_EX))), FILE_DISPOSITION_INFORMATION_EX_CLASS);
            if (status != STATUS_SUCCESS || unchecked((int)io.Status.ToInt64()) != STATUS_SUCCESS)
                throw new NativeFsException("NtSetInformationFile(FileDispositionInformationEx)",
                    status != STATUS_SUCCESS ? status : unchecked((int)io.Status.ToInt64()));
        }

        internal static string ToLowerHex(byte[] bytes)
        {
            if (bytes == null) throw new ArgumentNullException("bytes");
            StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder(bytes.Length * 2);
            for (int i = 0; i < bytes.Length; ++i) result.Append(bytes[i].ToString("x2", CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
            return result.ToString();
        }

        internal static bool TryCancelAndDrain(SafeFileHandle handle, IntPtr overlapped, SafeWaitHandle notificationEvent)
        {
            if (handle == null || handle.IsInvalid || handle.IsClosed || overlapped == IntPtr.Zero ||
                notificationEvent == null || notificationEvent.IsInvalid || notificationEvent.IsClosed) return false;
            bool cancelled = CancelIoEx(handle, overlapped);
            int cancelError = cancelled ? 0 : Marshal.GetLastWin32Error();
            if (!cancelled && cancelError != ERROR_NOT_FOUND) return false;
            if (WaitForSingleObject(notificationEvent.DangerousGetHandle(), 5000) != WAIT_OBJECT_0) return false;
            uint transferred;
            bool completed = GetOverlappedResult(handle, overlapped, out transferred, false);
            if (completed) return true;
            return Marshal.GetLastWin32Error() == ERROR_OPERATION_ABORTED;
        }

        internal static NativeFsException LastWin32(string operation)
        {
            int error = Marshal.GetLastWin32Error();
            return Win32Failure(operation, error);
        }

        internal static NativeFsException Win32Failure(string operation, int error)
        {
            return new NativeFsException(operation, error, new Win32Exception(error));
        }

        private static ulong ToUnixNs(long windowsTime100ns)
        {
            if (windowsTime100ns < WINDOWS_TO_UNIX_EPOCH_100NS) throw new NativeFsException("SnapshotCore", "pre-Unix timestamp rejected");
            return checked((ulong)(windowsTime100ns - WINDOWS_TO_UNIX_EPOCH_100NS) * 100UL);
        }

        private static string GetFinalPath(IntPtr raw)
        {
            uint required = GetFinalPathNameByHandleW(raw, null, 0, 0);
            if (required == 0) throw LastWin32("GetFinalPathNameByHandleW(size)");
            if (required > 32767) throw new NativeFsException("GetFinalPathNameByHandleW", "path exceeds bound");
            StringBuilder buffer = new StringBuilder(checked((int)required + 1));
            uint written = GetFinalPathNameByHandleW(raw, buffer, checked((uint)buffer.Capacity), 0);
            if (written == 0 || written >= buffer.Capacity) throw LastWin32("GetFinalPathNameByHandleW(value)");
            string value = buffer.ToString();
            const string prefix = @"\\?\";
            if (!value.StartsWith(prefix, StringComparison.Ordinal) || value.StartsWith(@"\\?\UNC\", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                throw new NativeFsException("GetFinalPathNameByHandleW", "non-DOS-drive final path rejected");
            value = value.Substring(prefix.Length).Replace('\\', '/');
            if (value.Length < 3 || value[1] != ':' || value[2] != '/' || !((value[0] >= 'A' && value[0] <= 'Z') || (value[0] >= 'a' && value[0] <= 'z')))
                throw new NativeFsException("GetFinalPathNameByHandleW", "invalid drive path");
            value = Char.ToUpperInvariant(value[0]) + value.Substring(1);
            if (value.Length > 3 && value.EndsWith("/", StringComparison.Ordinal)) value = value.Substring(0, value.Length - 1);
            return value;
        }

The self-test declaration exact own-key set is `caseIds`, `count`, `sha256`. `caseIds` is the exact ordinal-sorted 95-case roster, `count` is that array length, and `sha256` is its domain-separated canonical roster hash.

The native-assembly declaration exact own-key set is `assemblyByteLength`, `assemblySha256`, `compiler`, `referenceCount`, `referenceRosterSha256`, `sourceByteLength`, `sourceSha256`. Length/count fields are safe integers; hash fields are lowercase 64-hex; `compiler` is the fixed deterministic recipe literal. The assembly bytes themselves occur only in the library section as canonical base64.

A start progress row exact own-key set is `boundary`, `expectedCommitMessage`, `manifestLeaf`, `ordinal`, `ownedPaths`, `phaseId`, `predecessorKind`, `predecessorLeaf`, `progressLeaf`, `redCommandId`, `redCommands`, `redReceiptLeaf`, `requiredEvidenceIds`, `requiredEvidenceRosterSha256`, `rowId`, `testPaths`.

A complete progress row exact own-key set is `boundary`, `diffAfterCommandId`, `diffAfterReceiptLeaf`, `diffBeforeCommandId`, `diffBeforeReceiptLeaf`, `expectedCommitMessage`, `greenAfterCommandId`, `greenAfterReceiptLeaf`, `greenBeforeCommandId`, `greenBeforeReceiptLeaf`, `greenCommands`, `manifestLeaf`, `ordinal`, `ownedPaths`, `phaseId`, `predecessorKind`, `predecessorLeaf`, `progressLeaf`, `requiredEvidenceIds`, `requiredEvidenceRosterSha256`, `requiredReviewKinds`, `reviewChallengeLeaf`, `reviewReceiptLeaves`, `rowId`, `testPaths`.

No nested object permits undeclared fields. The manifest has exactly 56 sections, 54 action templates, 50 progress rows, 83 final changed paths, and 26 environment entries. Section declarations contain marker codes rather than duplicating full marker lines. All integer values are within the interoperable safe-integer range.

### Section extraction and bundle reconstruction

Each marker line below occurs exactly once in the committed plan. A section is the raw UTF-8 byte interval immediately after its begin-line LF and immediately before its end marker. The interval includes its terminal LF and excludes both marker lines. CR, BOM, NUL, duplicate/nested/overlapping markers, a declaration inside any marker interval, wrong length/hash, role drift, operation drift, predecessor drift, or row-binding drift is fatal.

After the plan commit, the operator derives the containing commit, Git blob OID, and SHA-256 from the committed blob. It then constructs the complete bundle from the exact section roster and the 54 PC-substituted action identities. Section-roster, action-roster, and full-bundle hashes use the design-specified domain separators and canonical preimages; their arrays are the same objects in the same order, not separately supplied lookalikes. Only the compact counts, roster hashes, plan identity, and complete bundle hash cross into permanent external records.

### Action re-entry protocol

The 54 action identities are state machines and may be invoked again only under their same exact action-specific command contract. Re-entry does not create a second action identity and never accepts a selector:

1. `capture` runs the embedded RED/GREEN self-test, obtains the exact trusted transcript prefix ending at the approved user confirmation record, and create-news the fixed sidecar and fixed approval. A crash may be resumed only through the exact same fixed identities and crash arm.
2. `task0_verify` is read-only and requires the exact plan/design ancestry, permanent external chain, repository binding, clean index, the one known unstaged draft, and no untracked files. It opens the known draft no-follow with mutation-denying sharing before the first Git query, verifies its fixed hash and full held identity, and retains the draft plus ancestor handles through the composite repository snapshot and result emission.
3. `consume` acquires that same known-draft lease before its first repository query and retains it through claim and receipt create-new/adoption, both post-create repository snapshots, and result emission. The first progress-start boundary repeats the same simultaneous lease-plus-repository observation before persisting its start state. Thus the fixed draft hash and the Git state cannot be sampled from different worktree views. Claim-without-receipt may resume only by exact descriptor/use identity.
4. A start-row action first creates its manifest/progress from the unchanged predecessor repository state and stops. The trusted task then makes test-only edits on the row's exact `testPaths`; the same action captures the expected failing RED command receipt and stops. Later re-entry revalidates the exact HEAD/test-only state, reruns RED fresh, and requires equality of the deterministic command contract/result projection before reporting authorization for the trusted task to implement the production change; timing-bearing raw TAP bytes remain preserved evidence but are not a stable-equality field.
5. A complete-row action first runs the exact precommit GREEN commands, saves the fixed receipt, and stops for the trusted task to stage exactly the row-owned paths. Re-entry reruns GREEN, validates the exact staged path set, records the fixed staged diff check, and stops for the trusted task to create the one exact-message non-merge commit. The next re-entry adopts only that exact commit after parent/path/tree/clean-state validation. The operator never performs an implicit stage or commit, and the trusted task may act only on the immediately preceding fixed status.
6. The same complete-row action after that commit derives parent/tree/paths and creates the fixed review challenge, then stops. Two fresh distinct trusted reviewers are required for every slice; `r4-6h` requires the third `independent-final` review.
7. After the reviews exist, the same complete-row action parses their exact trusted commentary records, writes fixed review receipts, reruns the exact GREEN and diff gates, and requires their deterministic projections to equal the stored contract/result projections before it create-news the complete manifest then progress record. Timing-bearing raw output hashes remain evidence of each run and are not required to repeat byte-for-byte. Any gap, rollback, second commit, dirty unowned path, stale challenge, deterministic receipt drift, or reviewer reuse is fatal.
8. `complete` requires all 50 contiguous manifest/progress pairs, the clean final state, and exact ordinal-sorted 83-path base-to-HEAD diff; it then create-news the permanent completion record. Completion prohibits any further repository mutation under this use.

The trusted review commentary body is exactly the ASCII prefix `WAVE0A-TRUSTED-REVIEW-V1 ` followed by one single-line canonical JSON object and no prefix/suffix line. Its exact own-key set is `commit`, `criticalFindings`, `diffSha256`, `importantFindings`, `phaseId`, `reviewKind`, `reviewerId`, `schemaVersion`, `startHead`, `verdict`. Required literals are schema `bob-builtin-analyze/wave0a-terminal-lf-trusted-review/v1`, the challenge phase/start/commit/diff identities, the row review kind, zero critical and important findings, and verdict `pass`. Reviewer IDs must be distinct within the row.

The provider transcript schema does not carry cryptographically or mechanically verifiable subagent provenance. Accordingly, distinct `reviewerId` strings are assertions, not independent proof of actor identity. The same trusted Codex task that owns the action must dispatch the required review kinds to separate fresh reviewer tasks, observe their task identities and returned findings outside this provider JSONL projection, and emit each canonical commentary assertion with a one-to-one fixed mapping from that observed reviewer task to `reviewerId`. The operator verifies freshness, row/commit/diff binding, required review-kind coverage, zero findings, and distinct asserted IDs; it does not claim to derive reviewer provenance from message text. If the trusted task cannot establish the separate-task mapping, it must not emit the assertion and the row cannot complete.

### Self-test and external evidence boundary

The self-test uses only the fresh fixed root `C:/Users/stell/source/archives/bob_builtin_analyze/2026-08-29-wave0a-terminal-lf-operator-self-test`. It materializes the test section first, observes the full-roster RED identity while the library is absent, then materializes and reloads the exact library without clearing the authenticated invocation state and observes all 95 cases GREEN. It verifies canonical JSON/transcript/bundle/template/cap/native/process/progress/legacy rejection arms, the executable-only ctime rule with every other identity field still fail-closed, the known-draft mutation-denying lease, held identities, create-new, bounded I/O, inventories, protected sentinel, and same-handle cleanup. An existing root, identity drift, partial leaf, reparse/hard link, unexpected inventory, failed cleanup, or sentinel change is not adopted, repaired, or deleted.

Permanent sidecar, approval, claim, receipt, command/review receipts, evidence manifests, progress records, and completion are repository-external fixed leaves. They are created no-follow and create-new under held directory handles, canonicalized with one terminal LF, flushed, reopened, and identity-verified. The operator never overwrites, renames, truncates, or cleans these leaves. Their allowed crash recovery is only exact-byte adoption of the one fixed leaf.
